title: Ground-penetrating radar finds 50-ft reinforced concrete structure
summary: Ross Coulthart tells of Ground-penetrating radar finds 50-ft reinforced concrete structure, about 2025 at Bradshaw Ranch, Sedona, Arizona, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He did a ground penetrating radar check on the road around Bradshaw Ranch, and we found a 50-ft wide reinforced steel concrete, highly visible on ground penetrating radar.

He did a ground-penetrating radar check on the road around Bradshaw Ranch. And we found a 50-ft wide, reinforced steel concrete, highly visible on ground-penetrating radar, literally just under the ground.
tellings.difference: Adds that the structure was literally just under the ground.
tellings.link_reason: Same ground-penetrating radar check by Paul and Coulthart that found a 50-ft reinforced concrete structure under the road around Bradshaw Ranch.

as_told.title: Ground-penetrating radar finds 50-ft reinforced structure under Bradshaw Ranch road
